episodes.title: TV Special
episodes.synopsis: A warrant's been issued for an arrest but this time, it's not for Lupin. Authorities are after Inspector Zenigata as they suspect Pops has been in cahoots with the master thief all along. In an effort to vouch for Zenigata's innocence, Lupin is challenged to steal the curious Time Crystal. As Lupin and his gang go after the famed diamond he's confronted with the unexpected betrayal of his most trusted partner...

info.title: Ultraman (ITA)
info.synopsis: Sono passati diversi anni dagli avvenimenti con protagonista Ultraman e il leggendario “Gigante di Luce” (Hikari no Kyojin), sparito dopo aver combattuto gli alieni giganti che invasero la Terra. Il figlio di Shin Hayata, Shinjiro, sembra possedere una strana abilità, e sarà proprio questa, insieme all’incredibile scoperta di essere il figlio di Ultraman, a guidarlo, fino a farlo a diventare il nuovo Ultraman: l’unico in grado di combattere gli alieni che stanno nuovamente invadendo la Terra.

episodes.title: A Power That Shouldn`t Be on This Earth
episodes.synopsis: Decades since he last merged with Ultraman, Shin Hayata learns of a new threat to Earth. His son, Shinjiro, also shows signs of superhuman strength.

episodes.title: An Inescapable Fate
episodes.synopsis: Wearing a protosuit, Shin is critically injured while saving Shinjiro from Bemular's attack. In desperation, Shinjiro returns to rescue his father.

episodes.title: Being Ultraman Isn`t Bad
episodes.synopsis: With Bemular paving the way for other alien species to attack Earth, SSSP's Edo asks Shinjiro to take on the mantle of Ultraman.

episodes.title: Release the Limiter!
episodes.synopsis: Shinjiro is sent on a mission to exterminate a hostile alien, but the target flees into the city, endangering countless civilians.

episodes.title: City of Aliens
episodes.synopsis: At Rena's concert, an alien calling himself Adad demands a confrontation with Ultraman. Things go from bad to worse when Bemular joins the fray.

episodes.title: The Curse of Ultraman
episodes.synopsis: Shinjiro's reluctance to execute homicidal aliens deeply concerns agent Moroboshi. Shin shares with his son what it truly means to be Ultraman.

episodes.title: Hidden Thoughts
episodes.synopsis: Embattled at first, Shinjiro finds his resolve and activates a latent power during his fight against a hostile alien. Rena prepares for a big concert.

episodes.title: The Beginning of Truth
episodes.synopsis: Shinjiro fears that his cover may be blown by an underclassman. Later on, he's taken aback when a rogue Ultraman shows up to aid him in battle.

episodes.title: Nice to Meet You, Brother
episodes.synopsis: Seiji has a tense confrontation with Shinjiro and Moroboshi over the use of his powers. Rena asks Shinjiro to give Ultraman a message.

episodes.title: Star Council
episodes.synopsis: Seiji dreams of a day when aliens are accepted openly on Earth. Hoping to fight for this cause, he pleads with the SSSP to bring him on board.

episodes.title: You as You Are
episodes.synopsis: Moroboshi, Shinjiro and the might of the SSSP sets out to protect Seiji on his quest to punish those responsible for the airline tragedy 12 years ago.

episodes.title: Ace Killer
episodes.synopsis: The Ultraman trio are fighting a losing battle against the mercenaries, but just when things seem hopeless, Shinjiro's dormant power finally awakens.

episodes.title: A Real Ultraman
episodes.synopsis: After uncovering evidence of alien involvement in a string of bizarre homicides, SSSP agent Moroboshi contacts an informant inside an alien enclave.

info.title: Le bizzarre avventure di JoJo OAV (1993) (ITA)
info.synopsis:
La prima serie di OAV narra le vicende della parte finale dell'arco Stardust Crusaders del manga "Le bizzarre avventure di JoJo" di Hirohiko Araki.
La storia segue Joseph Joestar e il nipote Jōtarō mentre tentano di mettere fine alla lunghissima faida familiare contro l'immortale vampiro Dio, risvegliatosi dopo 100 anni. I due trovano nel viaggio diversi alleati e con loro affronteranno Dio e altri nemici al suo servizio dando vita a battaglie in cui i guerrieri di entrambe le fazioni sprigionano i loro "Stand", un'estensione del corpo e della mente del suo portatore, generata dalla sua stessa energia vitale. Riusciranno Joseph e Jotaro a sconfiggerlo e a guarire Holly, figlia di Joseph e madre di Jōtarō, colpita da una maledizione al risveglio del vampiro?

episodes.title: The Fool Iggy and The God of Prosperity N`dul Part 1
episodes.synopsis: Jotaro and his companions finally reach Egypt. There, they are met by a Speedwagon Foundation helicopter that delivers a new addition to their group—a dog named Iggy who is actually the user of The Fool Stand. When the helicopter crashes just a short time later, the group investigates, only to find themselves pitted against another of DIO's assassins—N'Doul and his deadly Stand, the Egyptian god Geb.

episodes.title: The Fool Iggy and The God of Prosperity N`dul Part 2
episodes.synopsis: Jotaro and the others find themselves stranded and at the mercy of N'Doul's incredibly strong and mercurial Stand Geb. Faced with almost certain death, Jotaro makes a desperate gambit and forces Iggy to help him strike back at N'Doul, but Iggy has other plans. He betrays Jotaro at a critical moment, offering him to Geb in order to save his own life.

episodes.title: Gambler D`Arby
episodes.synopsis: The companions search the huge Egyptian capital of Cairo, showing everyone they meet the photo of a mysterious building where they think DIO resides. In an odd café, they encounter a gambler named D'Arby who claims to have the information they need. The catch is, they have to beat him in the ultimate wager—one where their very souls are at stake thanks to the use of his Stand Osiris. After Polnareff and Joseph fall victim to D'Arby's cheats, Jotaro must come up with a way to out gamble a gambler.

episodes.title: Dio`s World - The Void, Vanilla Ice
episodes.synopsis: The century-old blood feud finally comes to a close in the final battle between Jotaro and DIO. The World seems invincible as Jotaro is struck time and time again with murderous blows. If Jotaro cannot discover the secret of DIO's Stand and find some way to counter it, the Joestar line will come to an abrupt and bloody end.

episodes.title: Dio`s World - Kakyoin, Battle in the Force Field
episodes.synopsis: DIO pursues Joseph through the streets of Cairo, leaving an incredible swath of death and destruction in his wake. Kakyoin comes to Joseph's aid, only to be crushed by the power of DIO's Stand The World. As Kakyoin lies alone and dying, he realizes in the last moments of life the true nature of DIO's Stand, and he attempts to send them one final message to reveal that The World can stop time.

episodes.title: Dio`s World - The Void, Vanilla Ice
episodes.synopsis: The century-old blood feud finally comes to a close in the final battle between Jotaro and DIO. The World seems invincible as Jotaro is struck time and time again with murderous blows. If Jotaro cannot discover the secret of DIO's Stand and find some way to counter it, the Joestar line will come to an abrupt and bloody end.

info.title: Ryoko's Case File
info.synopsis: Yakushiji Ryoko no Kaiki Jikenbo è un poliziesco i cui casi sconfinano sempre nel soprannaturale. Protagonista e despota di questa storia è Yakushiji Ryoko, sovrintendente del dipartimento di polizia, il cui padre è il presidente della più importante agenzia di sicurezza giapponese. Izumida, invece, è il braccio destro di Ryoko, o forse sarebbe meglio dire che è il suo baby-sitter, visto che è pagato per assecondare e contenere i suoi capricci. Attorno a loro altri poliziotti, altri sovrintendenti, alti funzionari della polizia e governativi, imprenditori corrotti e megalomani dalla sanità mentale dubbia, oltre a maid tuttofare e ad alcune fan di Izumida-kun.

episodes.title: Ginza Crime Tower (First Part)
episodes.synopsis: Superintendent Ryōko Yakushiji and her subordinate, Assistant Inspector Junichirō Izumida of the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department, launch an investigation after they witness a man combust somewhere in Ginza. The two officers learn that the combustion cases may be tied with a known religious cult, but Ryōko has to endure her rivalry with fellow superintendent Yukiko Muromachi and an assassin out to get her.

episodes.title: Ginza Crime Tower (Last Part)
episodes.synopsis: Ryōko nearly survives an assassination attempt with the assassin sacrificing herself by ingesting a suicide pill that made her combust. She and Izumida continue to investigate, with their case getting complicated when a forensics scientist the two officers knew for a long time is the leader of the cult and that they had been using growth hormones to make an ordinary snake grow large.

episodes.title: Sakuradamon Case
episodes.synopsis: Two newspaper reporters try to follow Ryōko and Izumida around in order to get a potential story to be used against the former, but are seemingly thwarted in their plans when JACES security forces intervene on Ryōko's behalf.

episodes.title: Musashino Twilight
episodes.synopsis: Ryōko and Izumida investigate a former Health, Labour and Welfare minister due to illegal human experimentation of human cells with cells from an unknown human species, which resulted in a monster-like infant. The two officers try to eliminate the creature before they decided to let it die due to rapid cell degeneration.

episodes.title: The Bug That Crawls the Omotesandou
episodes.synopsis: A mad counter-terrorist robot goes haywire after a traffic accident and kills armed security guards. Ryōko and Izumida are drawn to the situation after the former had claimed of hearing gunshots. The situation becomes complicated when Izumida's elementary school cousin Mana gets involved and armed tactical teams of Japan Private Police (JPP), a JACES rival, are secretly deployed in order to destroy their own invention and conceal evidence on the victims the robot had killed.

episodes.title: Maid in Kasumigaseki
episodes.synopsis: Marianne and Lucienne, Ryoko's maids, arrived in Narita International Airport after the two subdued a thief after kicking their baggage cart to knock him out. The two maids, with Ryoko and Izumida, investigate the appearance of a giant salamander beneath the Greater Tokyo Area with an underground resort being under by corrupt politicians as they use armed gunmen to kill the creature.

episodes.title: Okinawa, God`s Island
episodes.synopsis: Ryoko and Junichiro head to Okinawa to investigate the reclusive JPP founder Ryojin Tadomura. As the two begin their stay in the island, mutant seeds from mangrove trees that were experimented on by JPP scientists are responsible for having its personnel turn against humans until the mutateed mangrove in the destroyed Tadomura villa is destroyed by Marianne by napalm grenades.

episodes.title: Tamagawa Suicide
episodes.synopsis: When numerous people are committing suicide, including a well-known police forensics scientist, Ryoko and Izumida investigate it and find out that a university professor and a new species of ultrasound crickets are responsible for the mysterious suicides with some of them still alive after the professor's death by a crashing truck.

episodes.title: Shiba`s Queen
episodes.synopsis: Ryoko goes into hiding after the media broadcasts negative articles and news reports about her fame and her standing with the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department. Ryoko takes Izumida to a NPP stronghold in the Greater Tokyo Area after being defamed by a secret organization of renegade police officials led by a woman named Ruriko Isurugi. In the NPP stronghold, Ryoko and Izumida discover a child who has the same identical facial features like the former.

episodes.title: Trap in Azabu
episodes.synopsis: Ryoko and Izumida find out that the child had no memories of herself, dubbing her Monami. Meanwhile, Ruriko makes an alliance with the Defense Minister on taking on Ryoko after reports of explosions have hit the DK Pharmaceuticals and other public buildings. Distraught over Ryoko planning on keeping her out of Japan, Monami runs away only to be captured by JPP operatives in an ambush with centipede robots until a giant toad came out of a nearby lake and assisted Izumida.

episodes.title: Princess of Takanawa
episodes.synopsis: Monami seeks refuge with Izumida after escaping from captivity. Ryoko reveals that Ruriko had co-founded JACES as the Japanese Empire Security Service but left after her grandfather Masamoto refused to allow Ruriko to use JESS as a refuge for ex-Imperial military servicemen to revive a true Japanese armed forces. Izumida learns from Kazuma, Ryoko's personal assistant, that Monami was cloned in order to wrestle control of JACES away from the Yakushiji family using an ancient technique of making people called Hangon and cloning technology.

episodes.title: Tokyo Dead or Love (First Part)
episodes.synopsis: Ruriko and other conspirators in the JGSDF and the JPP had planned to crush Ryoko Yakushiji and the whole of JACES under the guise of anti-terrorist training for the Greater Tokyo Area. Ryoko decides to fight Shiba on her own with JPP forces attacking both her and her own subordinates with Muromachi's. Izumida leaves the Yakushiji residence to see Ryoko, who had been previously attacked by an AH-64 Apache and a Type 90 MBT when another Type 90 arrives in a harbor to finish off Ryoko for good.

episodes.title: Tokyo Dead or Love (Last Part)
episodes.synopsis: The Type 90 tank, revealed to be under the control of Marianne and Lucienne, is used by Ryoko and Junichiro to head to Central Tokyo as they take out renegade JGSDF Type 90s to defeat Ruriko by taking out Tokyo Tower as the source of the radiowaves that had been used to brainwash JPP operatives under her command. Monami was rescued by Ryoko and Junichiro after defeating Ruriko and Kazuma as the JPP operatives, with their brainwashing removed, panic in fear due to the destroyed Tokyo Tower.

info.title: Hell Teacher: Jigoku Sensei Nube
info.synopsis: Meisuke Nueno, chiamato anche Nube, insegna nella scuola elementare della città di Domori. In verità in Nube si nasconde l'identità di un esorcista il cui compito è difendere la città dai numerosi eventi soprannaturali che incombono quotidianamente. Egli è in grado di far fronte a tali minacce grazie al potere donatogli dal demone rinchiuso nella sua mano sinistra. In tutto ciò però Nube non sarà solo, ma circondato dai suoi studenti che lo aiuteranno a riportare la città alla normalità... o a metterla in pericolo?!

episodes.title: The 99-Legged Bug
episodes.synopsis: The town of Domori may be plagued by mysterious phenomena, but things are not going well for Class 5-3's new homeroom teacher Meisuke Nueno, either. Right from the start, Nueno, or "Nube" for short, becomes the target of fifth-grader Hiroshi's bursts of rage. After witnessing something bizarre, Nueno suspects there may be an otherworldly reason behind Hiroshi's sudden personality change.

episodes.title: Rampage of the Fox Demon
episodes.synopsis: Nueno uses his ultimate weapon Demon Hand to exorcise the Yokai possessing Hiroshi. But suddenly, the mysterious and handsome Tamamo appears, kidnapping Hiroshi right before Nueno's eyes! As Nueno gives chase, Tamamo makes preparations throughout town for an unknown ritual. Just why did he kidnap Hiroshi, and what is his true identity?

episodes.title: The Midnight Honor Student
episodes.synopsis: An unsettling shadow appears in the school in the dead of night. It's rumored that an honor student is erasing blackboards, replacing flowers of flower vases, and cleaning the rabbit cages when there should be no one there. To get to the truth of the matter, Hiroshi and his friends sneak into the school, only to encounter a voice in the dark saying, "Let's be friends!"

episodes.title: The Rokurokubi
episodes.synopsis: After witnessing Nueno's amazing power, Miki becomes obsessed with gaining psychic abilities. She even tries to train while sleeping. When her efforts produce an unusual result, she joyfully celebrates her success. However, her friends are far from impressed. In fact, they are scared of what Miki has become.

episodes.title: Hatamonba`s Curse
episodes.synopsis: Katsuya will do anything to make his sister Manami happy, even if it means he has to run around borrowing money. That is how he unwittingly falls victim to the evil spirit Hatamonba's trap. When he realizes Hatemonba's deadly blade is not only pointing at his own neck, but also his sister's, he runs to Nueno for help. However, Hatamonba's sword appears to be mightier than Nueno's Demon Hand.

episodes.title: The Teketeke Ghost
episodes.synopsis: Fear grips Makoto after he hears about Teketeke, the spirit of a girl who lost her lower body in a railway accident. According to the story, now she wanders the world in search of new legs. Makoto grows desperate for help upon learning that the spirit is coming for him within three days. However, Nueno urges him to forget everything, insisting that Teketeke is nothing more than a myth.

episodes.title: The Unseasonable Yuki-Onna
episodes.synopsis: As unseasonable snow blankets the town of Domori, a beautiful young woman appears before Nueno. Her name is Yukime, and she has come to fulfill a promise she made to him five years ago. Excited by their teacher's improbable romance, Nueno's students sneakily tag along on their date, only to witness Yukime's frosty intentions.

episodes.title: Great Inventions and Spirit World Communicators
episodes.synopsis: Young inventor Akira finds a broken tablet and becomes even more obsessed with building great machines, as if he is possessed by something. One day, Akira announces he can bring the dead back to life, scaring his friends. Nueno senses something is wrong and investigates Akira's inventions, when he notices something strange within Akira's tablet...

episodes.title: The Girl Who Brings Happiness
episodes.synopsis: Zashiki-warashi is a yokai that brings happiness to humans. When Nube encounters one, he offers her a snack and she quickly grows attached to him. Before long, all of Class 5-3 starts to have amazingly good luck! Wanting to return the favor, the kindhearted Makoto and his friends hatch a plan to thank her, only to uncover glimpses into her sorrowful past.

episodes.title: The Night Parade of Yokai
episodes.synopsis: Born into a wealthy family, Shuichi carelessly tosses aside anything he no longer needs. He has long forgotten the importance of caring for his belongings until one day, he unwittingly picks up a tattered yellow umbrella. The umbrella suddenly reveals itself as a yokai and kidnaps Shuichi, forcing him to join an array of discarded objects in the Night Parade of Yokai.

episodes.title: Demon Hand vs Fire Tail Jutsu
episodes.synopsis: Tamamo, the fox demon Nube vanquished for trying to take Hiroshi's skull, reappears one day at Domori Elementary. When a furious Nube confronts him, Tamamo says he is no longer interested in Hiroshi and declares a temporary truce. However, he suddenly attacks the students of Class 5-3. It soon becomes apparent that Tamamo's true target is not the students, but Nube's special power.

episodes.title: Spirit Beast vs Spirit Fish
episodes.synopsis: Remugyo, a giant spirit monster, appears at Domori Elementary and lays eggs on the backs of Nube's students. Knowing the eggs will kill them once they hatch, Nube faces a nightmare worsened by Remugyo’s terrifying ability to regenerate. As Tamamo attempts to learn the secret to Nube's incredible power, the eggs begin to hatch. Nube bets his life on one last desperate attempt to save his students.

episodes.title: The Human Faced Tumor
episodes.synopsis: Nube is not showing up for school, and there are rumors about a mysterious person living in the old school building. Hiroshi and his friends sneak into the building to investigate, only to find Nube possessed by a demon and unable to use his Demon Hand. Now his students must muster all their courage to save their teacher.

info.title: AD Police Files
info.synopsis: Anno 2027 a MegaTokyo, sei anni prima dal debutto del Cavaliere Sabers. I Boomers (umani artificiali) restano relativamente una nuova tecnologia, e l'implemento e l'integrazione dei boomers all'interno della società rimane ancora combattuta. Ogni qual volta che si verifica un incidente dei boomers, però, entra in gioco la Polizia Avanzata, una forza speciale addestrata per affrontare i crimini boomers.

related.title: A.D. Police: To Protect and Serve

variants.title: A.D. Police: To Protect and Serve

episodes.title: The Phantom Woman | Voomer Madness
episodes.synopsis: The Phantom Woman is an introductory episode in the beginning arc of AD Police showing us a rogue boomer that cannot be taken down by the normal police and the assistance of the AD Police are called in to help. After killing a few of the advanced police, the squad commander orders the boomer to be killed by the firing squad, destroying the storefront the boomer worked at in the process.

episodes.title: The Ripper | The Paradise Loop
episodes.synopsis: After a gruesome murder on the subway in an area called Paradise Loop, AD Police steps in to help find the killer when the normal police don't seem up to the task. A total of six prostitutes are found to all have been murdered on this subway line and it's suspected the work is done by a boomer. Two officers of the normal police are cast in this episode to help find the killer and bring it to justice.

episodes.title: The Man Who Bites His Tongue | I Want Medicine...
episodes.synopsis: This episode stars Billy Fanword, Captain of the AD Police Spacial Mobile Squad. After sustaining massive injures, due to a rogue boomer, and almost dying, his only remaining viable organs (brain and tongue) are transplanted into an experimental battle cyborg body. To help remind him he was once human, he is seen at times biting his tongue. During the course of the episode, Billy slowly loses touch with his humanity, because of a selfish and overly prideful doctor that helped to “make him”.

info.title: Hipira: The Little Vampire
info.synopsis: Nella città di Salta, un luogo dove il sole non splende mai, vive una comunità di vampiri. La storia ruota attorno a Hipira, un piccolo vampiro che vive la vita di un comune ragazzo, frequentando la scuola e affrontando i bulli, ma che ha anche un debole per esplorare, fare scherzi e vivere grandi avventure.

info.title: Ar Tonelico: Sekai no Owari de Utai Tsuzukeru Shoujo
info.synopsis: Aurica Nestmile è una giovane Reyvateil, ossia appartiene ad una razza capace di trasformare il proprio canto in magia; Aurica sta attraversando un periodo di dubbi e sofferenza perché sente che la sua canzone magica non è di grande utilità per nessuno. Dall'alto della torre Ar Tonelico a bordo di un dirigibile arriva un certo Lyner Barsett, che però perde il controllo della nave e si schianta sul terreno. I due si incontrano, e mentre cercano qualcuno capace di riparare il dirigibile, finiscono per aiutarsi l'un l'altro nella ricerca di sé stessi.

episodes.title: OVA
episodes.synopsis:
At a time when Aurica is saddened over her inability to fulfill her role as a Reyvateil, or one who can control magical powers through singing Songs, Lyner's airship comes crashing down upon her from the sky. Both of them search for an engineer to repair his airship, meeting Krusche. In the process, Lyner inadvertently teaches Aurica that the key to singing a successful Song is to want to help others from the bottom of one's heart.

Based on Ar Tonelico RPG game for the PlayStation 2

info.title: Super Heavy God Gravion
info.synopsis: Siamo nel 2041 d.C. Un nuovo nemico chiamato Zeravire appare improvvisamente nel sistema solare, distruggendo tutte le installazioni militari che incontra. Tuttavia, un uomo facoltoso di nome Klein Sandman era già a conoscenza dell'imminente invasione e per questo stava preparando segretamente il suo esercito per la battaglia. La sua carta vincente è Gravion, un robot gigante che utilizza la gravità come fonte di energia. Nel frattempo il giovane Eiji entra di nascosto nella base di Sandman alla ricerca della sorella scomparsa. Finirà, insieme ad altri cinque ragazzi a salire a bordo del super-robot Gravion, per cercare di respingere la minaccia Zeravire.

episodes.title: The Fortress of the Deity
episodes.synopsis: While searching for his missing sister, Eiji Shigure secretly enters the castle of millionaire Klein Sandman. There he meets the castles strange inhabitants and is selected to join in Sandmans mission to stop a destructive alien known as the Zeravire. The teams weapon, a series of fighting robots designed by Sandman called the Gran Kaiser and the Gran Divas who when needed join together to form Gravion.

episodes.title: Mission of Gravity
episodes.synopsis: Eiji begins to get used to life in Sandman's castle and to the castles inhabitants. As he and Toga venture to the forbidden area of the castle in search of Eiji's sister Ayaka and the identity of the G-Shadow's pilot, Raven attempts to convince the EFA to allow Earthgertz to take the lead in the defense against the Zeravire.

episodes.title: Labyrinth
episodes.synopsis: When a ghostly figure is sighted in one of the castle's towers, Toga and Eiji go to investigate. There they discover Leele, the mysterious pilot of the G-Shadow.

episodes.title: Labyrinth
episodes.synopsis: When a ghostly figure is sighted in one of the castle's towers, Toga and Eiji go to investigate. There they discover Leele, the mysterious pilot of the G-Shadow.

episodes.title: The Girl Who Wouldn`t Laugh
episodes.synopsis: In an effort to get to know each other better, the team goes on a picnic together but Leele is hesitant to share as she is haunted by nightmares of her past. Meanwhile the EFA attempts to find information of Sandman.

episodes.title: Toga`s Day Off
episodes.synopsis: Eiji sneaks out of the castle during the staffs shopping day and takes Toga along with him for his first day out of the castle and his first day in the big city. As the maids search for them, the Zeravire launch an attack on the city.

episodes.title: Drill Girl on the Beach
episodes.synopsis: On the anniversary of her father Isanas death, Luna returns home to the island of Okiaowa but is surpirsed when she finds that the rest of of the Gran Knights have decided to accompany her to the have some fun on the island. But all fun is soon ended when the Zeravire target the International Peace Conference for their next attack.

episodes.title: Storming the Castle
episodes.synopsis: When the Zeravire attacks the the castle, all hope of stopping it lies with Eiji, who has accidentally found himself piloting the Gran Kaiser. To survive he must call upon all the power of the Gran Kaiser and all that his body can withstand.

episodes.title: A Distant Embrace
episodes.synopsis: Repairs begin on the castle following the attack by the Zeravire and Eiji begins to recover from his battle but runs from his physical and runs into Mizuki who gives him insight to the disappearance of his sister Ayaka. Together they decide to investigate where she vanished, the West Tower.

episodes.title: Crack
episodes.synopsis: Following recent events, Sandman reluctantly has an auto-pilot device, The Gran Phantom intstalled into the Gran Kaiser in case of emergency. And one does arise when a Zeravire with a nuclear power supply attacks and one of the maids is put in danger, causing Eiji to try and rescue her while the rest of the Gran Knights use the system and go into battle with out him.

episodes.title: The Thing That Was Lost
episodes.synopsis: After seeing what darkness Toga is capable of in the heat of battle, Eiji quits the Gran Knights and leaves the castle to return to a normal life. Leele ventures to town to convince Eiji to come back. Two pilots down, Gravion must operate with its auto-pilot taking up the slack when the Zeravire attack.

episodes.title: Because You`re With Me
episodes.synopsis: The battle wages on as Gravion fights against the attacking Zeravire with a failing auto-pilot and Eiji and Leele still missing. But after his friend Yumi is injured in the attack, Eiji decides that his place is with the rest of the Gran Knights on Gravion.

episodes.title: White Steel Fang
episodes.synopsis: The Zeravire have been evolving, not in order to destroy humans, but to ensure the destruction of Gravion. When the new and improved Zeravire comes to Earth to challenge Gravion, Sandman is hesitant to let the Gran Knights go to battle but they refuse to sit on the sidelines. With no other choice, Sandman must authorize the use of Gravions most adavanced weapon.

info.title: Mao
info.synopsis: Nanoka è una normale studentessa delle medie. Sopravvissuta a un inspiegabile incidente anni prima, la sua vita prende una svolta quando, attraversando una vecchia galleria nel suo quartiere, si ritrova catapultata nell’era Taishō: un Giappone oscuro e intriso di eventi soprannaturali.In questo mondo incontra Mao, un enigmatico esorcista maledetto, alla ricerca di un'entità demoniaca legata al suo passato. Nanoka si ritrova coinvolta nei suoi scontri contro il soprannaturale, e man mano che i misteri si infittiscono, il suo stesso passato torna a galla. Insieme affrontano yōkai, rituali occulti e misteri del passato, cercando risposte su ciò che li lega e su come fermare la minaccia che li coinvolge.

episodes.title: Nanoka and Mao
episodes.synopsis: Nanoka is an attuned adolescent. So when a covered shopping arcade beckons, a strange world awaits.

episodes.title: Spider Lady
episodes.synopsis: Nanoka discovers that the arcade links to the Taisho era, while Mao probes a mysterious murder case.

episodes.title: The Accursed
episodes.synopsis: Nanoka is unharmed by Mao's cursed sword. She returns to modern times to investigate an accident.

episodes.title: The Shorinkyo Incident
episodes.synopsis: Nanoka and Otoya infiltrate the Shorinkyo cult, but get trapped inside by the leader, Shoko.

episodes.title: The Keystone
episodes.synopsis: Earthquakes plague Taisho-era Fifth Street. Mao and Otoya find a church atop a sacred keystone site.

episodes.title: Memories of That Day
episodes.synopsis: Nanoka reveals that she is from 100 years in the future. She goes back in time to question Mao.

episodes.title: The New Vessel
episodes.synopsis: In the Taisho era, Nanoka is abducted by Byoki. Mao tries to help but collapses.

episodes.title: Hyakka
episodes.synopsis: Mao is attacked by Hyakka, a fire-wielding onmyoji. He reveals a secret about the Goshikido.

episodes.title: Kamon
episodes.synopsis: Mao and the gang help the injured Tenko. Kuchinawa, who appears on the scene, turns out to be Kamon.

episodes.title: Taizanfukun
episodes.synopsis: A giant made of fish and water demands that Mao teach him the ultimate onmyoji spell, Taizanfukun.

episodes.title: Blood Bond
episodes.synopsis: Mao tries to help a sick boy but walks into a trap. A shikigami attacks Mao, trying to capture him.

episodes.title: Water Sorcerer
episodes.synopsis: Mao recalls the Goko Clan's water sorcerer. Kamon reunites with Shiranui at a water temple.

episodes.title: Byouki
episodes.synopsis: Nanoka carries Byoki's message for Mao to the Taisho era. Kamon exposes Shiranui's scam.

episodes.title: The Iron Mask
episodes.synopsis: Rumors of a life-extending Goko Clan onmyoji lead Kamon and Mao to investigate Yurako.

episodes.title: Shiranui
episodes.synopsis: Shiranui demands the Taizanfukun spell from Mao, but Mao is enraged that Yurako is working for him.

episodes.title: Hakubi
episodes.synopsis: Hakubi attacks Mao with Metal sorcery. Mao transforms into a beast and goes on a rampage.

episodes.title: Maogui
episodes.synopsis: After battling Hakubi, Mao falls into a deep sleep. Nanoka and Shiraha investigate cats and Onmyodo.

episodes.title: Natsuno
episodes.synopsis: Natsuno reveals Daigo and Sana's past. Mao and Kamon unlock the mystery of the Undersea Shrine.

episodes.title: The Undersea Shrine
episodes.synopsis: Mao and his crew head for the Undersea Shrine. Kamon is driven into a corner by Shiranui's sorcery.

episodes.title: Sana`s Heart
episodes.synopsis: Kamon seeks Masago's stolen body. Natsuno links Yurako's evil energy to Sana's death.

episodes.title: Soma
episodes.synopsis: After battling Ichima Kagami, Mao takes the injured Soma to the clinic, but Soma slips away.

episodes.title: Risk My Life
episodes.synopsis: A cursed puppet needle transforms Mao into a beast and turns him against his friends.

episodes.title: The Sleepwalking Patient
episodes.synopsis: Mao follows a patient who slips out of the hospital to eat grave dirt and uncovers a powerful curse.

episodes.title: Traveling Performers
episodes.synopsis: Natsuno discovers a buried village, but seeks Kamon's help after being attacked by ayakashi.

episodes.title: Ghouls and Rakshasas
episodes.synopsis: Kagari Hosho attacks Nanoka, but Mao rescues her. Kagari tracks her down and takes her to Yurako.

episodes.title: Yurako`s World
episodes.synopsis: Yurako reveals her past as a vessel for curses in the Heian period and her first meeting with Mao.

info.title: Deadman Wonderland (ITA)
info.synopsis: Per Ganta Igarashi, in fin dei conti, poteva trattarsi di un gita scolastica qualunque. Il parco di divertimento “Deadman Wonderland” è però un luogo insolito, nel quale i carcerati si esibiscono in ogni genere di pratica rischiosa, pur di accontentare i gusti ludici del pubblico. Prima di partire per la gita, i compagni di Ganta vengono brutalmente assassinati da un misterioso uomo in rosso. Il destino è doppiamente crudele per il ragazzo, accusato dalle autorità del massacro. Uscirne non è un gioco, e Ganta dovrà sopravvivere, vincendo dei giochi a dir poco sadici, resi pericolosi da un letale collare...

related.title: Deadman Wonderland: The Red Knife Wielder

variants.title: Deadman Wonderland: The Red Knife Wielder

episodes.title: Death Row Inmate
episodes.synopsis: As Ganta Igarashi and his classmates plan for a class trip to Deadman Wonderland, a privately owned prison that also serves as an amusement park, a mysterious red man appears and changes their lives forever.

episodes.title: Antidote (Candy)
episodes.synopsis: Ganta learns from a fellow inmate, Yō Takami, that in order to have a decent meal in the prison, he needs to earn Cast Points. He learns of a 'Dog Race' in which he can win a big prize, which he and Shiro decide to enter. In the lockerroom, they encounter a fierce inmate named Kazumasi Kouzuma who drives fear into the others until the warden silences him. Ganta soon learns that in order to avoid being killed by a poison, he needs to eat an antidote known as Candy, which was secretly stolen from his bag by Yō the other day. Ganta realises that in order to survive, he needs to win the race in order to purchase a new one, but he soon learns the course is littered with actual death traps. Thanks in part to Shiro's innocent manner, Ganta and Shiro make it to the final stage against Kasumasi where they have to hold onto a ball and avoid falling into a spike pit. Ganta decides to stand up to Kazumasi, who eventually falls to his death. In the closing moments of the round, Ganta is forced to sacrifice the ball, and the prize money, in order to keep Shiro from falling and keep their promise of eating the runner up prize together.

episodes.title: G Block
episodes.synopsis: Put in charge of observing him by the promoter, Tsunenaga Tamaki, Yō gives Ganta a piece of Candy so he can keep living, unaware that he's putting him in his debt. Meanwhile, the red man, known as the Wretched Egg, breaks lose and appears before Ganta. Ganta tries attacking him using his own abilities, before the Wretched Egg escapes and Ganta falls unconscious. After waking up, Ganta hears from the other witnesses that they keep Wretched Egg locked up in the G-Block of the prison, so he and Shiro head towards there. Deeming him dangerous, Captain Makina puts the facility on lockdown and sends a fierce security robot after Ganta. As it approaches them, Ganta and Yō follow Shiro into a secret passage leading to the G-Block. As Shiro confronts the robot, it is destroyed by the arrival of another inmate with the same powers as Ganta.

episodes.title: Crow Claw
episodes.synopsis: Believing him to be the red man, Ganta attacks the strange inmate, known as Senji "Crow" Kiyomasa, but falls at a disadvantage against the blades he can form with his blood. After learning the nature of his power, The Branches of Sin, Ganta launches a counterattack, though soon realizes he is not the red man, but one of several 'Deadmen' with that power. Crow tries to attack Ganta again, but finds himself weak against Shiro before a special unit appears, tranquilising Ganta and Crow and taking Shiro and Yō to an empty corridor. As Ganta is examined, he comes face to face with Tamaki, who reveals he rigged Ganta's jury verdict to get him sent to Deadman Wonderland before revealing Ganta will face off against Crow in a battle the next day, tempting him with the prospect of coming face to face with Wretched Egg. As Ganta is tortured with footage of what a Corpse Carnival entails, Makina decides to confront the director concerning the mysteries of Block G.

episodes.title: Carnival Corpse
episodes.synopsis: Ganta is thrusted into his Corpse Carnival match with Crow and is at a disadvantage as his projectiles use too much blood and cause him to develop anemia. As he becomes helpless, he recalls memories of Shiro and manages to stand back up, using the environment to get a hit on Crow. After escaping from the corridor, Yō and Shiro head towards G-Block after Yō hears the whereabouts of a women he is searching for. After Ganta recovers from his victory, he is horrified to find that Crow is forced to have one of his eyes removed as a result of losing. As Yō uses Shiro as a diversion so he can escape on his own, he bears witness to her true destructive ability, as she herself has the Branches of Sin.

episodes.title: Hummingbird
episodes.synopsis: As Shiro falls unconcsious and is picked up by some strange men whilst Yō continues his way to G-Block, Ganta meets a girl named Minatsuki, another Sin user who had killed her abusive father. Ganta offers to help Minatsuki escape, but soon learns she is his opponent in the next Corpse Carnival. When the match begins, Minatsuki's personality changes completely and attacks with her whip-like Branches of Sin, revealing she had manipulated him into taking an injury prior to the match. However, Yō appears, revealing Minatsuki to be his little sister, saying that he plans to gain enough Cast Points to buy her freedom before entering the arena. Minatsuki tries to manipulate Yō against Ganta, but he turns on her instead, having learnt the truth behind his father's death. Minatsuki captures Yō and uses him as a human shield against Ganta, revealing she has shown hatred ever since her mother left her for dead during the Red Hole incident. Ganta manages to disable one of her whips and free Yō, before knocking her out with a headbutt, winning the match.

episodes.title: Wretched Egg
episodes.synopsis: After a strange quake occurs, during which Yo rushes to keep Minatsuki from harm, Ganta starts to remember things about Shiro, who is revealed to be the Wretched Egg. As Ganta recalls his childhood with Shiro, Yo can't bring himself to mention what he had seen her do. As Yo goes to recover the casts that were stolen from him, he learns from Tamaki that casts can't be used to reduce the sentences on G-Block inmates and is attacked by Genkaku, part of an Anti-Deadman force known as the Undertakers. Meanwhile, Ganta meets Nagi "Owl" Kengamine and Karako Koshio, members of a Deadman group known as Scar Chain wanting to destroy Deadman Wonderland, who invite him to join their gang. As Minatsuki goes through her penalty game, Nagi arranges it so that she only loses her hair. Just then, Genkaku appears and attacks Ganta and the others.

episodes.title: Scar Chain
episodes.synopsis: Ganta is saved by the arrival of Shiro, who is back under control by the lullaby, to which Genkaku decides to retreat. Afterwards, Ganta is introduced to the other members of Scar Chain, who are plotting to expose Deadman Wonderland's secrets an inspection week, which Makina also plans to take advantage of to find out what secrets are being hidden from her. However, Ganta becomes a little distrustful when his claims of his Branches of Sin being stopped by Genkaku differ from what the security cameras show and takes his leave. Ganta later learns from Crow about how Genkaku killed Nagi's wife, later hearing from Nagi about how each member of Scar Chain has their own ideas of freedom. As Ganta promises to take Shiro on a ferris wheel when they escape someday, it is shown that one of Scar Chain's members, Binjou Rokudo, is a double agent for the Undertakers. Ganta decides to join Scar Chain, who begin their operation to leak information about the Deadmen to the outside world. As Nagi and Rokudo go to the security room, Ganta and the others are chased by an acid spewing robot, to which Karako opts to stay behind to save the others.

episodes.title: Worm Eater
episodes.synopsis: After recalling the time she joined Scar Chain, Karako defends herself from the acid spewing robot and destroys it, falling down with it. Meanwhile, Nagi is betrayed by Rokudo and confronted by an Undertaker named Hibana Daida, who uses a special weapon to neutralize his Branches of Sin. As Hibana starts slicing off bits of Nagi's flesh, he provokes her into chopping off his arm, giving him the opportunity to activate the elevator Ganta's group needs to take. However, Ganta's group is confronted by Genkaku and his men, leaving only Ganta and a few others left alive to carry the chip containing the information. Whilst bleeding to death, Nagi makes a call to the hideout, which is heard by Shiro who catches up to Ganta and throws the chip, which was actually a bomb, into a fire.

episodes.title: Undertaker
episodes.synopsis: Ganta becomes angry at Shiro for throwing away the data chip, telling her he never wants to see her again. Meanwhile, Mikuni investigates Tamaki's office, overhearing a conversation between him and the Defense secretary concerning the Deadmen. As Karako and the others discuss their next plan, Rokuro appears and reveals the data chip was actually a bomb he had made before announcing that the group is being held hostage unless Nagi agrees to become an Undertaker. As Rokuro decides to execute Ganta first, Crow appears on the scene, managing to fight back against the Undertakers using sonic blasts. As Shiro laments her situation with Ganta, she meets Toto "Mockingbird" Sakigami, the one who told her about the bomb.

episodes.title: Gig of Despair
episodes.synopsis: Detesting his weak self, Ganta asks Crow to teach him how to use his Branches of Sin to fight. Meanwhile, Karako attempts to infiltrate the Undertakers by disguising herself as a guard. As Toto appears before Ganta and Crow during their training session, Shiro, who gets drunk off of liquer sweets, appears before Genkaku, who also discovers Karako. Just as Ganta manages to produce a blood bullet that can break the sound barrier, Genkaku announces his capturing of Karako and Shiro. Despite being low on blood, Ganta rushes to where Genkaku, Karako and Shiro are, but is confronted by Nagi, who had been broken by Genkaku into a raging demon.

episodes.title: Grateful Dead
episodes.synopsis: As Nagi goes on a rampage on all the guards, Ganta stands to protect Shiro, taking all of his punches and trying to reason with him. As Nagi starts to come to his senses thanks to the bell Karako wears reminding him of his friends, Karako is suddenly stabbed by Genkaku. Nagi stands to protect his friends but is shot by Genkaku, who begins killing the other guards, whilst Ganta starts being poisoned due to not having any Candy in a while. Hibana tries to escape but is killed by Toto, who had managed to obtain Crow's abilities after drinking his blood. As Shiro enters Wretched Egg mode, the stone in Ganta's chest glows and blasts a powerful shot, with Nagi holding Genkaku in place as they are both taken out. Before passing on, Nagi gives Ganta his last piece of Candy. As Karako and some others escape, Ganta decides to stay behind so he can protect his friends.

info.title: One Piece: Heroines
info.synopsis: Le protagoniste femminili di One Piece sono al centro di una raccolta di brevi storie autonome. Nami partecipa a una sfilata di moda che avrà un impatto significativo sul suo percorso. Robin collabora con Koala e Sabo nell’analisi di un antico manufatto. La principessa Vivi riceve una lettera anonima da un ammiratore e riflette sulla situazione. Perona si trova coinvolta in una disputa con Zoro e Mihawk per l’ultima bottiglia di vino.

episodes.title: TV Special
episodes.synopsis: After buying poorly made shoes, Nami returns to the shop and meets Lebno, the designer. He offers to create a new pair from scratch, on the condition that she becomes his model. However, the craftsperson Miucha is the one who does the work.

info.title: The Ramparts of Ice 2
info.synopsis: Seconda stagione di The Ramparts of Ice

episodes.title: Nuvole e pioggia
episodes.synopsis: Il cielo grigio riflette l'umore inquieto del gruppo. Momoka intuisce l'opportunità di avvicinarsi a Minato, mentre Miki riesce a malapena a guardare in faccia Yota dopo averlo respinto.

episodes.title: Fermarsi e ripartire
episodes.synopsis: Iniziano i preparativi per il festival culturale e il rapporto tra Miki e Yota torna gradualmente alla normalità. Ma mentre Minato fa i conti con il desiderio di restare vicino a Koyuki, Momoka decide di fare la sua mossa.

episodes.title: I Veri Sentimenti
episodes.synopsis: Sconvolta dalla notizia che Minato e Momoka stanno insieme, Koyuki fatica a mantenere la calma. Nel frattempo, Miki chiede a Minato quali siano le sue vere intenzioni.

episodes.title: Relief
episodes.synopsis: In agony over Minato, Koyuki confides in Tsukiko — who sees what Koyuki refuses to. Then a run-in with Igarashi forces her to reflect on her own walls.
